prompt: Generate a short news headline and a brief introductory paragraph (3-5 sentences) that represents a legitimate, non-clickbait news article with a professional journalistic approach. Policy Report: UK Parliament Votes to Approve Brexit Deal

Global Crisis: Flash Floods in Germany Leave Over 180 Dead
